reviewer_statement: Provisional developer six-domain scientific plotting audit only. Source Matplotlib data tests are authored but exact-head execution is not witnessed and no independent full Python source-contract certification is claimed.

Native validated fitted-slope time grid and dimension names, finite precomputed uncertainty arrays, or native sparse FPCA score_diagnostics frame with status masks. Arbitrary Python pandas/dataclass and injected Matplotlib axes protocols are explicitly out of scope.

Pointwise percentile FPCR slope uncertainty at observed grid, source fill_between alpha 0.2, fitted slope, zero reference, titles, axis labeling and source confidence label. Committed native numerical and direct frozen Python Matplotlib source artist comparisons use pinned 1.2 public exports. Exact-head CI execution has not been witnessed.

Invalid R strict flags, unknown dimension, malformed numerical shape, nonfinite bounds, missing diagnostics and nonpositive conditioning fail explicitly. Native R errors need not match Python exception class identity.

Default R plots and invisible source numerical returns unchanged. Strict mode yields a typed native R source scientific record with ordered source artist geometry, original plot labels and metadata. Does not return a live Matplotlib Axes or pixel image.
Pointwise bootstrap percentile uncertainty around an already-fitted FPCR Gaussian slope. No refitting or familywise coverage is invented.
